highlevel_contract.direction: GHL signed current-state input to One Time; One Time outbox projects sanitized access status back to GHL

free_pilot_acceptance: Verified adult activation creates one explicit, time-bounded free_pilot access projection.
Parent creates up to three separate Student identities with separate credentials.
A Student signs in from another device and sees only approved content for that learner.
Revocation or expiry invalidates Student sessions and blocks learning access.
No public form submission, learner identity, GHL tag, or legacy billing row can grant access by itself.
validation_required: State transition, expiry, precedence, replay, cross-account, and ambiguous-identity tests
Free Parent activation through another-device Student login and revocation
No fallback authorization from legacy entitlement rows
No writes to payment-history or Stripe-shaped tables
Typecheck, build, lint, secret scan, exact-head staging deployment, and browser acceptance
remaining_work: The persistent-staging conductor must assign exactly one implementation task before code work.
The implementation must reconcile current entitlement call sites and cut authorization over to the new projection without creating a payment ledger.
GHL UI/payment-provider work remains in the separately controlled GHL lane.
